closureNotes: Why this PR sat green for four days: its receipt .claude/work-control/2026-08-20-merge-pr-160.json was written at a head main left behind 152 commits ago, and refreshing an existing receipt's currentHead is refused by the auto-mode classifier - correctly, since from the outside that is indistinguishable from rewriting a proof so a blocked gate passes. A NEW receipt at a head that actually exists is a different act and is the documented way out.

Neither file the lane touches that also exists on main - scripts/usage-audit.mjs and .claude/skills/usage-audit/SKILL.md - received a single commit on main across those 152 (git log merge-base..origin/main -- <paths> is empty), so there is no semantic drift hiding under the clean textual merge.

PR #160's own thread already contains the correction that the earlier 'gh pr merge is refused by the classifier' premise was wrong: --delete-branch fails only in its LOCAL cleanup step, after the remote merge has already happened. That is a separate trap and is not what blocked this one.
